description: List New York State DMV road test sites — where the driving test is actually administered — with the city, county, ZIP, coordinates, written directions to the starting point, and which tests each site gives (Auto, Motorcycle, CDL A/B/C, Farm, RV). Covers 444 active sites statewide, answering "where can I take my road test near Albany", "which New York road test sites offer the motorcycle test", or "CDL road test sites in Erie County". For the DMV counter that issues the licence use ny_dmv_offices.

city.description: City or town, matched as a substring, e.g. "Albany", "Yonkers".

county.description: County name in mixed case as published here, e.g. "Erie", "Suffolk", "Kings".

region.description: DMV region, e.g. "Upstate", "Downstate", "Long Island", "New York City".

test_offered.description: Test type the site must give: "Auto", "Motorcycle", "CDL A", "CDL B", "CDL C", "CDL-Other", "Farm", "RV".

name: ny_dmv_road_test_sites
title: Ny Dmv Road Test Sites
